title: Reduced effective resolution from averaging in self-attention
description: Self-attention computes representations as weighted averages of position vectors, which reduces effective resolution compared to convolutional or recurrent approaches. The authors note this as a cost of the constant path length between positions and state that multi-head attention is used to counteract this effect.
canonical_description: self-attention reduces effective resolution by averaging over positions

evidence.anchor: reduced effective resolution due to averaging attention-weighted positions
evidence.quote: In the Transformer this is reduced to a constant number of operations, albeit at the cost of reduced effective resolution due to averaging attention-weighted positions, an effect we counteract with Multi-Head Attention as described in section~[REF:sec:attention].
